capabilities.description: Read a Customer/Account record.
Create a Customer/Account record.
Edit a Customer/Account record's non-governed fields.
Edit an Account's governed commercial fields (paymentTerms/taxStatus) -- Issue #175, admin-only today.
Create a Work Order.
Perform a Work Order lifecycle transition via the transitionWorkOrder authority (ADR-002).
Cancel a Work Order, subject to the dispatcher in-flight-technician narrowing preserved from today's behavior.
Author or change the planned parts (qtyPlanned) for a Work Order via the governed setWorkOrderPartsPlan producer. Does not reserve, consume, or procure.
Create or advance a Sales Opportunity (lifecycle transition) via the governed opportunity command. Pre-commitment only; does not create Work Orders, inventory movement, or invoices.
Read the minimal Sales Opportunity projection via the trusted listOpportunityContext read service (backend-resolved scope; no client-direct collection read).

Create a committed Sales Order from a WON Opportunity via the governed createSalesOrderFromOpportunity action. Human-invoked only (no trigger); account and lines are server-derived from the Opportunity, never client-supplied.

Read the minimal governed Sales Order projection (identity, account, source Opportunity, lifecycle state, lines with the ordered/allocated/fulfilled/billed quantity model, service Work Order lineage) via the trusted getSalesOrderContext read service. Backend-resolved scope; no client-direct sales_orders read.
Create or advance a committed Sales Order (lifecycle transition) via the governed salesOrder command. Does not assign serialized assets, write Work Orders, or move inventory.

Allocate a committed Sales Order against authoritative inventory availability via the governed allocateSalesOrder command. Records allocation only on the Sales Order; does not write the inventory ledger or Equipment authority.

Create governed Service demand (a Work Order via the governed Work Order authority) for a committed Sales Order, with demand lineage. Does not author Work Order state, assignment, or schedule directly.

Issue a governed invoice (per-company number, server-recomputed amounts, immutable ISSUED record + audit) for a committed Sales Order's billable lines via the trusted issueInvoice command. Does not compute tax authority, re-price, or write client-visible financial data.

Record a cash receipt and apply it to an invoice (maintaining the invoice's derived AR projection + audit) via the trusted applyPayment command. Does not expose client-direct financial writes or edit an outstanding balance independently of its facts.

Record an explicit linked invoice adjustment (credit memo / debit charge / write-off) and maintain the invoice's derived AR projection + audit via the trusted recordInvoiceAdjustment command. Does not rewrite the issued invoice or expose client-direct financial writes.

Read the minimal Finance AR projection (invoice + derived AR position) for an account via the trusted listAccountInvoiceAr callable. Backend read only; the client never reads invoices/payments/adjustments directly.

Record a refund (money returned after payment) and reverse the applied payment on the invoice via the trusted recordRefund command. Does not rewrite the issued invoice, collapse into a negative payment, or expose client-direct financial writes.

Create a Sales Territory or a Commercial Coverage Assignment via the governed coverage command. Records durable coverage facts only; does not resolve precedence, credit, or commission, and exposes no client-direct writes.

Resolve the commercial coverage (all effective, matching coverage assignments) for a context via the trusted resolveCoverageForContext callable. Backend read only; returns every matching assignment (split coverage), never a single owner/credit/commission.
Read the Parts Manager queue/oversight/history views of reorder requests.
Read only the reorder requests assigned to the caller's own identity.
Submit a manual NEEDS_PLANNING reorder request via the zero-history quantity path.
Create a system-originated (READY-path) reorder request -- admin/dispatcher only today.
Assign a reorder request to a Parts Associate.
Transition an assigned reorder request to Start Purchasing.
Post a purchasing status update on an assigned reorder request.
Record a Purchase Order against an assigned reorder request.
Mark an assigned reorder request's Purchase Order as Received.
Approve a reorder request -- admin/dispatcher only today.
Reject a reorder request -- admin/dispatcher only today.
Cancel a reorder request -- admin/dispatcher only today.
Read reorder Purchase Orders / Purchase Order Voids.
Create a reorder Purchase Order.
Void a reorder Purchase Order -- admin/dispatcher, or the recorded assignee only.
Read inventory_transactions records.
Read inventory_actions records.
Create an inventory_actions record -- admin/dispatcher only today.
Read a warehouses record (physical warehouse site).
Read a stock_locations record (bin-level quantity within a warehouse).
Read a transfer_orders record (inter-warehouse stock transfer).
Object-level read gate for reporting on Customer/Account records.
Report field-read: customer.name.
Report field-read: customer.status.
Report field-read: customer.relationshipTypes.
Report field-read: customer.billingAddress (street/city/state/zip -- one capability, grouped per Spec §5.1).
Report field-read: customer.tags.
Report field-read: customer.customerNumber/erpId/accountingId/legacyId (one capability, grouped per Spec §5.1).
Report field-read: customer.notes -- security-text, inactive pending the wave-1 review's explicit confirmation (Spec §5 sensitivity legend).
Report field-read: customer.createdAt.
Report field-read: customer.paymentTerms -- governed (Rules admin-only write, Issue #175).
Report field-read: customer.taxStatus -- governed (Rules admin-only write, Issue #175).
Report field-read: customer.defaultCurrency/purchaseOrderRequired/invoiceDeliveryMethod (one capability, grouped per Spec §5.1).
Report field-read: customer.billingContact (reference -> contact).
Report field-read: customer.accountOwner (reference -> employee) -- employee-sensitivity, deferred to wave 4 despite sitting in the wave-1 object table (Spec §4).
Object-level read gate for reporting on Contact records.
Report field-read: contact.name.
Report field-read: contact.email.
Report field-read: contact.phone.
Report field-read: contact.role.
Report field-read: contact.accountId (reference -> customer).
Object-level read gate for reporting on Location records.
Report field-read: location.name.
Report field-read: location.address.street/city/state/zip (one capability, grouped per Spec §5.3).
Report field-read: location.accessNotes -- security-text, inactive pending the wave-1 review's explicit confirmation (Spec §5 sensitivity legend).
Report field-read: location.accountId (reference -> customer).
Object-level read gate for reporting on Equipment records.
Report field-read: equipment.name.
Report field-read: equipment.status.
Report field-read: equipment.manufacturer/model/serialNumber/assetTag (one capability, grouped per Spec §5.4).
Report field-read: equipment.installedDate/warrantyExpiresDate (one capability, grouped per Spec §5.4).
Report field-read: equipment.notes -- standard (not security-text; distinct from customer/location notes, Spec §5.4).
Report field-read: equipment.accountId (reference -> customer).
Report field-read: equipment.locationId (reference -> location).
Report field-read: equipment.createdAt.
Create a saved report definition (trusted saved-definition service).
Read (get one or list one's own) saved report definitions (trusted saved-definition service).
Rename one's own saved report definition (trusted saved-definition service).
Duplicate one's own saved report definition (trusted saved-definition service).
Delete one's own saved report definition (trusted saved-definition service).
Enable/disable a principal's account status.
Assign or revoke an already-approved Role.
Approve or reject a pending Access Request.
Initiate an admin-initiated password reset for another eligible user (inactive pending a separate production/security gate).
Read the immutable Audit Event history.
Create and edit canonical Part and Manufacturer descriptive records (trusted Part Master service).
Change Part or Manufacturer lifecycle status (trusted Part Master service).
Read the minimal governed catalog/reference projection (Manufacturer identity/status) via the trusted getManufacturerCatalog read service. Backend-resolved scope; no client-direct manufacturers read.

Read the minimal governed Available Equipment projection (serialNo, partId, currentLocationId, inventoryState, currentEquipmentId, ownership) via the trusted getAvailableEquipment read service. Backend-resolved scope; no client-direct serialized_assets read.
Receive inbound stock into an inventory location against a reorder purchase order (trusted Receiving service).
Create a governed Transfer Order between two active WAREHOUSE/MOBILE(truck) inventory locations (trusted Transfer service).
Dispatch a REQUESTED Transfer Order (stage TRANSFER_OUT ledger effect(s), REQUESTED -> IN_TRANSIT).
Receive an IN_TRANSIT Transfer Order at its destination (stage TRANSFER_IN ledger effect(s), IN_TRANSIT -> COMPLETED).
Cancel a REQUESTED Transfer Order before any movement has been dispatched (REQUESTED -> CANCELLED).
Create a governed Cycle Count at an active WAREHOUSE/MOBILE(truck) inventory location, snapshotting expected quantity/serials from the ledger/registry authority (trusted Cycle Count service).
Record the counted quantity/serials for an OPEN Cycle Count and compute variance evidence (OPEN -> COUNTED).
Reconcile a COUNTED Cycle Count's variance by staging ADJUSTED ledger evidence (COUNTED -> RECONCILED); requires a reason on non-zero variance.
Cancel an OPEN Cycle Count before any count has been submitted (OPEN -> CANCELLED).
Read Part-Equipment compatibility relationships (future read service; no client read exists in D4).
Import Part-Equipment compatibility relationships and evidence (trusted Equipment command service).
Change the verification status of a Part-Equipment compatibility relationship (trusted Equipment command service).
Correct a governed Part-Equipment compatibility relationship (trusted Equipment command service).
Create and edit canonical Equipment Model records and their aliases (trusted Equipment command service).

Create a governed CRM Activity/Note (Sales Note, Call, Meeting, Relationship, or General) scoped to an Account, optionally referencing a Contact/Opportunity/Sales Order by id. Immutable identity; no assignee, due date, or completion state.

Read the minimal governed CRM Activity projection (type, body, occurredAt/createdAt, actor, linked Account/Contact/Opportunity/Sales Order ids) for one Account via the trusted getCrmActivities read service. Backend-resolved scope; no client-direct crm_activities read.

Read the minimal governed coordinated-Work-Order projection (id, woNumber, status, customerId, locationId, salesOrderId, salesOrderLineRefs) for active Work Orders that carry a salesOrderId, via the trusted listCoordinatedOperations read service. Backend-resolved scope; no client-direct fieldops_wos read.

callables.comment: --- Issue #15 surface: Work Order Engine v1.2 ---

WO Parts Planning Phase 2 -- the governed PLANNED producer. "export is not deployment": not deployed to the live project and no client calls it, and its capability (workOrder.parts.plan) is registered active:false (fail-closed for everyone) until a separate Owner deploy + grant gate.

Sales Opportunity governed write callables (Cycle 3). EXPORT != DEPLOY, REGISTER != GRANT: exported for build/test only; the `opportunity.write` capability is registered active:false (fail-closed) and nothing runs in production until a separate deploy + Owner grant.
Trusted minimal Opportunity READ projection (avoids client Rules widening). EXPORT != DEPLOY, capability `opportunity.read` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT).

P1.3 -- governed, human-invoked WON -> Create Sales Order action (decision #3: no Firestore trigger). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `opportunity.createSalesOrder` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT).
Sales Order trusted read projection. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `salesOrder.read` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT). Owner-ratified 2026-08-15 (see permissionCatalog.ts's entry).
Serialized Asset trusted Available-Equipment read (Spec phase M.1). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `inventory.serializedAsset.read` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT), granted to NO Role.

Coordinated Operations trusted read (fidelity fix, 2026-08-15) -- serves the existing coordinatedVisit/ coordinatedFieldMission pure projections from real fieldops_wos data. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `fulfillment.coordinatedVisit.read` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT), granted to NO Ro

Location-DISPLAY trusted resolver (sandbox-fidelity package PART 11A) -- id -> { type, label } for WAREHOUSE/MOBILE only, backing Available Equipment's location column. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `inventory.location.display.read` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT), granted to NO Role.
Sales Order governed write callables (Cycle 4). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `salesOrder.write` registered active:false (REGISTER != GRANT).
Fulfillment allocation (Cycle 5 live). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `salesOrder.fulfill` active:false.
Sales Order → Service seam (Cycle 7). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `salesOrder.service` active:false.

Finance (Billing/AR) — governed invoice issuance. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `finance.invoice.issue` active:false (ungranted); `invoices` is Admin-SDK-only (deny-all client Rules). Sensitive/audited.

Finance (Billing/AR) — governed payment application. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `finance.payment.apply` active:false; `payments`/`payment_applications` are Admin-SDK-only (deny-all client Rules). Sensitive/audited.

Finance (Billing/AR) — governed invoice adjustments (credit/charge/write-off). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `finance.adjustment.record` active:false; `invoice_adjustments` is Admin-SDK-only (deny-all client Rules).
Finance (Billing/AR) — trusted AR read projection. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `finance.read` active:false; backend read only (invoices stay Admin-SDK-only / deny-all client Rules).
Commercial Coverage & Territory (#15) — governed coverage writes. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `coverage.write` active:false; sales_territories / commercial_coverage_assignments are Admin-SDK-only.

Commercial Coverage & Territory (#15) — trusted coverage resolve (read). EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `coverage.read` active:false; backend read only (coverage collections stay Admin-SDK-only / deny-all).
Finance (Billing/AR) — governed refund. EXPORT != DEPLOY; capability `finance.refund.record` active:false; `refunds` is Admin-SDK-only (deny-all client Rules). Sensitive/audited.

guides.title: Sign in to Field Ops
guides.summary: Sign in with your work email and password; covers the login form, error message, No access state, and demo banner.

guides.title: Understand your landing screen
guides.summary: What you see after sign-in: the app frame plus the role-specific My Dashboard (live technician dashboard; placeholder for admin/dispatcher, who use Operations Dashboard).

guides.title: Move around the app
guides.summary: Using the top area tabs and sub-tabs, what each role sees, and an honest note that many sub-sections are not-yet-built placeholders.

guides.title: Sign out of Field Ops
guides.summary: Use the Logout button in the top-right to end your session, especially on shared devices.

guides.title: Browse and find work orders
guides.summary: Filter the work order list by lifecycle group and search for a specific one (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: View a work order's details
guides.summary: Open one work order to see customer, location, timestamps, parts, and history (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: Create a work order
guides.summary: Four-step wizard that fills in fine but can't save yet — the createWorkOrder Cloud Function is undeployed.

guides.title: Move a work order through its lifecycle (dispatcher)
guides.summary: Mark Ready/Schedule/Dispatch/Close/Cancel buttons exist but transitionWorkOrder is undeployed, so status changes can't record.

guides.title: Progress your assigned work order (technician)
guides.summary: Accept/Travel/Arrive/Start Work/Complete on My Dashboard; same undeployed transitionWorkOrder callable, so steps can't record.

guides.title: Schedule work orders (weekly workspace)
guides.summary: See the week ahead across every technician and put a date, time, and technician on Work Orders that are ready to schedule, at Service > Scheduling (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: Assign a job to a technician (Dispatch screen)
guides.summary: One-click assign an unassigned job to an available technician from the Service > Dispatch cards.

guides.title: Dispatch a Work Order (Dispatcher Board)
guides.summary: Review the Work Order queue with technician recommendations and dispatch a SCHEDULED Work Order by picker or drag-and-drop.

guides.title: Monitor operations (Control Tower)
guides.summary: Read-only operational overview: live counters, technician load, at-risk items, and a recommended dispatch queue.

guides.title: See my assigned work orders
guides.summary: Technician home dashboard: assigned work orders grouped by stage (Ready to Start / In Progress / Waiting / Completed Today) plus a performance snapshot.

guides.title: Update a work order's status
guides.summary: Move an assigned work order through its lifecycle (Accept, Start Travel, Arrived, Start Work, Complete) from the work order detail view.

guides.title: Record parts used and work notes
guides.summary: Adjust used quantities on planned parts and add append-only work notes via Execution Capture on an assigned work order.

guides.title: Parts Scanner (Technician Workspace)
guides.summary: Field part scan/lookup at Service > Technician Workspace; in-memory demo except the real governed **Receive a purchase order** action — see [Receive a purchase order](inventory/receive-a-purchase-order.md).

guides.title: Find a part and check its stock
guides.summary: Look up a part in the Parts catalog and read its stock position and reorder status (read-only).

guides.title: Request a reorder for a part
guides.summary: Flag a low part into the reorder queue via the Request Reorder control (one-click for forecastable parts; eligibility-gated manual qty for Needs Planning).

guides.title: Review a reorder request (approve or reject)
guides.summary: Approve a pending request to hand it to the Parts Manager, or reject it with a required reason.

guides.title: Assign a reorder request to a Parts Associate
guides.summary: Assign an approved request to a Parts-Associate-role employee via the employee picker.

guides.title: Place the order and track purchasing
guides.summary: Assignee-only: start purchasing, post progress updates, and record the purchase order (moves request to Ordered).

guides.title: Mark a reorder request received
guides.summary: Assignee-only closeout of an Ordered request; explicitly marked as NOT updating stock counts.

guides.title: View inventory transfers
guides.summary: Read-only Inventory > Transfers workspace: part, From → To locations, and status, filterable by Active/In transit/Completed/Cancelled/All (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: View warehouses
guides.summary: Read-only Inventory > Warehouses workspace: name, Active/Inactive status, and receiving eligibility, filterable by All/Active/Inactive, with a summary count (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: Receive a purchase order
guides.summary: The governed receipt: receive an Ordered purchase order into a warehouse. One workflow, two launch points — the **Inventory > Receiving** workspace (Admin/Dispatcher) or the Parts Scanner's "Receive a purchase order" act

guides.title: Cancel or void a reorder request
guides.summary: Reason-then-confirm flow: cancel before ordering (admin/dispatcher) or void after ordering (assignee only); nothing deleted.

guides.title: Log an inventory action (receive, adjust, or correct)
guides.summary: Record a Receive/Adjust/Correct audit note against a part; explicitly log-only and does not change stock.

guides.title: Parts scanner (Technician Workspace)
guides.summary: Mobile scan-and-act preview (use/load/count/PO draft are in-memory demo); its **Receive a purchase order** action is the real governed receipt — see [Receive a purchase order](inventory/receive-a-purchase-order.md).

guides.title: View purchase orders
guides.summary: Read-only Purchasing > Purchase Orders list of orders placed against reorder requests, filterable by Open/Received/Voided/All (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: View receipts
guides.summary: Read-only Purchasing > Receipts list of received purchase orders — the received-only view of Purchase Orders, with a link into Inventory > Receiving (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: View suppliers
guides.summary: Read-only Purchasing > Suppliers registry showing name, vendor number, contact, and status, filterable by All/Active/Inactive/Ungoverned (admin/dispatcher).

guides.title: Browse and search customers
guides.summary: View the customer list, search by name, and open a record.

guides.title: Add a new customer
guides.summary: Create a customer via the + New Customer form.

guides.title: View a customer's record
guides.summary: Tour the six sections of a customer detail page.

guides.title: Edit a customer
guides.summary: Change name, status, address, notes, tags, or external IDs.

guides.title: Add a contact to a customer
guides.summary: Record a contact person with phone, email, and primary flag.

guides.title: Add a location to a customer
guides.summary: Record a customer site with address and access notes.

guides.title: See a customer's work orders and activity
guides.summary: Read Completed/Open counts and the Account Activity timeline.

guides.title: Financial summary
guides.summary: Section exists but shows "Sales data source not connected." — no provider wired.

guides.title: Add and view employees
guides.summary: List field technicians and add a new one (name + phone) on the Administration > Employees screen.

guides.title: Read the integrations connection guide
guides.summary: Browse and search the Administration > Integrations FAQ and gather a readiness checklist before requesting a connection.
